potion.name: Health Potion
potion.text: Heals 50 HP. In a fight it takes your turn.

potion-2.name: Greater Health Potion
potion-2.text: Heals 90 HP. In a fight it takes your turn.

potion-3.name: Superior Health Potion
potion-3.text: Heals 160 HP. In a fight it takes your turn.

mana-potion.name: Mana Potion
mana-potion.text: Gives back 25 mana. In a fight it takes your turn.

mana-potion-2.name: Greater Mana Potion
mana-potion-2.text: Gives back 45 mana. In a fight it takes your turn.

mana-potion-3.name: Superior Mana Potion
mana-potion-3.text: Gives back 80 mana. In a fight it takes your turn.

elixir-arcana.name: Elixir of Arcana
elixir-arcana.text: Abilities hit 8 harder for three fights.

reroll.name: Do-Over
reroll.text: Roll the die again before you walk.

minus-one.name: Hold
minus-one.text: Hold back one step, never below one.

exact.name: Fairy Pick
exact.text: The fairy picks the number you ask for: walk exactly that.
